labelerView.description: Public projection of a registry labeler row, shared by the getLabelers and getLabeler queries. Internal fields (last_error, require_sig) are deliberately excluded.

id.description: Monotonically increasing identifier minted when the labeler is first registered; never reused.

createdAt.description: Date the relay first observed a labeler service declaration for this DID.

updatedAt.description: Date of the most recently observed labeler declaration update. Absent when this relay has not observed a declaration for the labeler.

endpoint.description: Labeler host, including its port when the DID document specifies one. Stays empty until the relay resolves the labeler's DID document.

enabled.description: Indicates whether this labeler is currently active. Labelers will be considered inactive if they have updated their service record to remove their labeler declaration.

last_upstream_seq.description: Sequence number last ingested from the labeler's upstream stream. null when the labeler has never been observed.

declarations.description: Declaration collections this labeler currently holds, as observed by this relay. Empty when no declaration has been observed (e.g. manually added labelers).
